record.question: The criminal seems to have acted in _________ with three others.
record.explanation: Answer C: collusion. Collusion is secret cooperation for an illegal or dishonest purpose; “acted in collusion with” is the idiom (C). Independent check: “Acted in collusion with” means acted secretly in concert. Reference: https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/collusion; https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/idiom; https://dictionary.cambridge.org/grammar/british-grammar/clauses. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Exact printed question, choices and required directions/emphasis reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
